data.other_hard: Child of a current or former Foreign Service employee who is an AFSA member, with the AFSA membership valid and not lapsed; not a child of AFSA Scholarship Committee members; for Financial Aid: claimed as a dependent on the most recent IRS tax form, minimum GPA of 2.75, demonstrated financial need; for Merit: not a previous Academic, Art, or Community Service Merit award winner, and gap-year applicants must apply within one year of high school graduation with no post-secondary coursework taken after graduation
data.evidence_sentence: Be the child of a current or former member of the Foreign Service, whose parent(s) is also a member of the American Foreign Service Association (AFSA).
data.notes: List page with different criteria per award. Financial Aid minimum GPA is 2.75 (no scale stated). Merit minimum GPA is 3.25 on a 4.0 scale for Academic Merit and 2.75 on a 4.0 scale for Art and Community Service Merit, so min_gpa and gpa_scale are left empty. Nationality is not stated; eligibility depends on a parent's Foreign Service membership. Degree levels: bachelor covers college/university programs; associate and trade/vocational programs are mapped to other. No application deadline is stated. Financial Aid must be reapplied for each year; Merit awards are one-time. Financial Aid cannot reduce university scholarships or grants. Host country is not stated. No award amounts are stated.
